episodes.title: The Drug Cult That Thought Murder Made Them Invincible | The Hole
episodes.description:
In 1989, college student Mark Kilroy disappeared while partying across the border in Matamoros, Mexico.

What police eventually uncovered at Rancho Santa Elena was considerably stranger than a normal murder case: thirteen bodies, a drug-smuggling operation, ritual sacrifice, an iron cauldron containing human remains, and a group of criminals who genuinely believed their leader could make them invisible to police and impervious to bullets.

That leader was Adolfo Constanzo, a 26-year-old Cuban-American occult practitioner known to his followers as El Padrino.

Constanzo built a pretty lucrative career selling spiritual protection to wealthy clients, police officials and drug traffickers before creating his own increasingly violent version of Palo. Eventually convincing members of a smuggling organization that human sacrifice could strengthen their supernatural protection.

In this Halloween episode of The Hole, we go all the way down the Adolfo Constanzo rabbit hole

Thanks for watching, Happy Halloween!
